fluff.overview: Clan doctrine generally treats conventional infantry as a necessary evil, though Clans like Hell's Horses have demonstrated that properly supported infantry can be an effective component of combined-arms operations. Mechanized Hover Points ride hovercraft that provide the fastest ground speed of any infantry transport, with the added capability of crossing water obstacles. This speed comes at the cost of durability, as hovercraft are fragile compared to tracked or wheeled vehicles, but in open terrain or coastal environments, few formations can match their ability to reposition quickly. Support squads operate portable machine guns that deliver sustained automatic fire, providing suppression capability that can pin down enemy infantry and threaten light vehicles.
